description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDependentsController class which manages the display and permissions related to employee dependents in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for pre-render setup, including setting up Vue.js components and permission checks.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentsController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling employee dependents view, setting Vue components, and managing permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee dependents data and permissions before rendering the view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups used for capability access checks related to dependents.
